description: TikTok video whose recipe is only spoken; the device supplied a transcript

payload.source_text: the 3 ingredient pasta everyone is making #pasta #easyrecipe
payload.transcript: Okay so boil about 200 grams of spaghetti. While that cooks, melt two tablespoons of butter and grate in a big handful of parmesan. Toss it all with a splash of pasta water and that's it.
